exact_scope: Complete finite caller-supplied candidate domains, canonical strict basic templates and caller-supplied rhyme groups only; objective is the sum of four width-three LocalConvScorer couplet scores on frozen per-cell token features and weights, evaluated in floating-point arithmetic. No global semantic, repetition, word-span, common-prefix or aojiu constraints. Reading verification is asserted by the caller, not inferred from meter; optimality concerns this objective, not literary quality.
